Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge
 Order

This contempt petition relates to an order dated 26.07.2013 whereby the writ Court came to dispose of the writ petition-OWP no. 707/2006 with a direction to the writ respondents to process the case of the petitioner, for payment of compensation for the land acquired, in accordance with law along with some attending direction.
The exercise was required to be done within a period of two months.

In this writ petition, the petitioner had pleaded that land measuring 1.4 kanal falling in khasra no.
2176 situated at Mohalla Lower Chowkian, tehsil Thanamandi, district Rajouri has been taken over by the Rural Development Department for the construction of Multipurpose Hall in the year 2004 without any compensation awarded to the petitioner. The direction of the writ Court having gone begging for compliance made the petitioner to file this contempt petition before this Court in the year 2014.

sentences.text:
Acting in furtherance to the direction of the writ Court, the Director Rural Development Department came to undertake requisite administrative exercise which is born out from communication no.
DRDJ/Court/1121/2006/60189-93 dated 26.02.2016 addressed to the Secretary to Government,
Department of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj, J&K Government.

entities.text: Department of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In terms of an order dated 04.04.2022 in this contempt petition, this Court came to register the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioner that the compensation amount payable to the petitioner has been sanctioned and the amount is lying with the Assistant Commissioner Development (ACD), Rajouri.

In terms of an order dated 25.04.2022, this Court while dispensing with the personal appearance of the Financial Commissioner (Additional Chief Secretary), Finance Department came to observe that in terms of Finance Department's communication dated 18.02.2021 authorized funds to the tune of Rs. 12.88 lacs for land acquisition for construction of CIC and Godown at Chowkri, tehsil Darhal,
district Rajouri have been released in favour of the Department of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj for the facility of the Rural Development Department to disburse the said compensation amount.

entities.text: Department of Rural Development and Panchayati Raj
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Today, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has come to receive a payment of Rs. 12.88 lacs towards compensation of the land so taken from him.
The receipt of this compensation is under protest as the petitioner has a right to seek its enhancement.

In the light of this, the present contempt petition is disposed of without prejudice to the right of the petitioner to seek reference under Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 against the final award dated 19.10.2019 passed by the Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Development),
Rajouri as the petitioner is not satisfied with the quantum of compensation so assessed with respect to his land.

Accordingly, the petitioner shall be well within his right to apply for reference of the matter to the Principal District Court, Rajouri and for that let needful be done at the end of the petitioner by putting up the requisite application before the Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Rajouri who shall deal with the same in accordance with the J&K Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990.
Disposal of this contempt petition is without prejudice to the position of either of the parties with respect to the award and any subsequent proceedings as may arise thereform.

entities.text: Collector Land Acquisition (Assistant Commissioner Revenue), Rajouri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Connected application(s) also stands disposed of accordingly.
